notes.title: Cowabunga Collection 2nd Patch
notes.content:
Totally radical! The 2nd patch update for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Cowabunga Collection brings online play to TMNT III: The Manhattan Project. Plus, original artwork from TMNT co-creator Kevin Eastman will be added to the Turtles’ Lair along with other Turtles memorabilia.

• Online play added to Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III: The Manhattan Project.
• Additional art added to Behind the Scenes in the Turtles’ Lair, including original Kevin Eastman illustrations created for the Cowabunga Collection.
• Additional ads added to Magazine Advertisements in the Turtles’ Lair.
• Invite feature fixed for Nintendo Switch.

notes.title: TMNT Collection First Update
notes.content: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection brings new game enhancements and an adjustable online multiplayer experience. Future patches will add online play to more iconic TMNT titles.
